summary: Request: Short-term SAST evaluation license (30 sandbox seats) and align renewal window with enterprise AppSec contract
description:
Issue summary: Security team requests a timeboxed evaluation for a SaaS SAST provider (vendor: Seeker Security, vendor-proxy) and 30 temporary sandbox seats to be provisioned for AppSec engineers and two product squads.

Business need/impact: Internal audit scheduled for 2026-04-20 requires evidence of SAST tooling in developer pipelines. AppSec needs to validate integration and false-positive rates on representative repos before committing to an annual contract. Without seats, we risk delayed audit artifacts and rework across engineering teams.

Scope: 30 sandbox seats for 60 days (2026-03-15 to 2026-05-15), trial account with SSO (Okta) + repo access for three GitHub org repos, and a quote for 12-month enterprise licensing with seat scaling options.

Timing: Trial must be live by 2026-03-18 to allow two weeks of baseline scans prior to audit prep.

Cost center / approver: Security (cost center SEC-OPS). Initial approval required from Security Manager (Priya Raman) and Finance approver (Alex Kim). Legal review needed for data handling clauses and subprocessors.

Required deliverables: Trial tenant, seat allocations list, sample scan reports for two backend repos, vendor SOC2 evidence, draft contract term sheet, and estimated annual pricing with seat bands.

Steps already taken: Contacted vendor (Seeker) for trial on 2026-03-09; vendor provided trial SLA and feature matrix. Security ran a quick smoke scan on a forked repo and observed initial noise; further tuning required.

Next actions: Procurement to initiate PO request; Legal to start DPA review; IT to add allowed vendor IPs and configure Okta SCIM provisioning.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Vendor provided trial token and trial tenant details on 2026-03-09.
2) Security created a scoped project and connected a forked backend repo for smoke scans.
3) Observed high false-positive rate on generated results; need rule tuning and baseline scans on target repos.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Lucas Nguyen: Opening request after initial vendor trial. Marking audit timeline as driving constraint.
2026-03-10 11:05 - Priya Raman (Security Manager): Please include 2 product squads (Search & Billing) in sandbox access list. Prioritize Okta SCIM if available.
2026-03-11 14:22 - Vendor Rep (Seeker): We can provision 30 seats and enable SCIM; provided temporary tenant URL and trial expiration 60 days from activation.
2026-03-12 08:30 - Maya Rodriguez (Procurement): Started quote request form; sending to Finance and Legal for expedited review.
2026-03-12 10:47 - Alex Kim (Finance): Marked as P1. Need rough annual quote to estimate budget impact before PO. Will expedite approval once we have price bands.
investigation_notes: Vendor trial established but SCIM provisioning requires Okta admin consent. IT team needs service principal configuration.
Initial smoke scan returned many style/format-related findings; engineering should whitelist known generated code directories and configure baseline suppression before scanning main repos.
Legal flagged vendor subprocessors list; Seeker provided SOC2 Type II report (2025) and a list of European sub-processors. DPA redline expected 2 business days after vendor returns latest clause.
resolution_notes: Pending: Procurement to raise PO when Finance confirms budget and Legal approves DPA. Expected go/no-go decision by 2026-03-16.

If approved, Procurement will provision 30 seats via vendor trial admin and create a seat assignment spreadsheet. IT will run SCIM sync and add IP allowlist entries. Security will run baseline scans and produce acceptance report for audit artifacts.

Follow-up tasks: (1) Create INT ticket to track permanent contract negotiation if trial metrics meet acceptance criteria. (2) Add renewal alignment request to the FY27 AppSec contract planning doc to co-term with org-wide AppSec vendor slate.
